changes.summary: listWorkspaces(): `select id, title` from sessions with no client filter — RLS scopes it to the caller's teams; an empty title becomes 'Untitled'.
loads the list while landing (waiting for profileId; a failure leaves it empty) and exposes `open(id)` to navigate.
the landing screen lists the workspaces as rows with a drifting arrow, adapts its heading/subtitle when the list is present, and labels the form 'New workspace'.
g5: the leader's list contains the workspace they created; a member of the seeded team sees the seeded one and not the new team's.

decisions: RLS is the filter; the query carries no where clause.
A read only: no meta write, no outbox op, so it cannot park.
A failed list is silent — the screen degrades to exactly what it was.
RULE-14 is untouched: a cached session still redirects straight to the last workspace.
